product.title: Samurai Jeans SSS25-SKSW Natural Indigo Sashiko Stripe Work Shirt
product.body_html:
• Intro
  • Details
  • Size Chart
  • How We Measure

- Built around a work-inspired design, the SSS25-SKSW brings a new character to the classic striped shirt through Samurai Jeans’ original indigo sashiko fabric. The clean shape keeps it easy to wear, while the textured stripe pattern gives the shirt a stronger and more distinctive presence.

To create this special fabric, the yarns are hand-dyed in two different shades of indigo before being woven into the sashiko stripe pattern. The subtle difference between the colours gives the stripes greater depth and natural variation. As the indigo gradually fades over time, the texture of the sashiko will become more visible, giving each stripe a more individual look.

Finished with rounded chest pockets, the shirt uses navy cotton twill inside the collar and along the inner front placket for contrast and reinforcement. Custom indigo-dyed nut buttons engraved with the Samurai name add another special touch, while triple-stitched Flat-Felled Seam construction provides the strength expected from a traditional work shirt. Together, these details complete a distinctive piece that will only become richer and more personal with time.

Constructed from 25oz special selvedge denim with a natural slub texture, the fabric starts out extremely firm and substantial, gradually softening and becoming more comfortable with wear. product.title: Samurai Jeans SJSLT-SC02 Samurai Cotton Mock Neck Long Sleeve Shirt
product.body_html:
• Intro
  • Details
  • Size Chart
  • How We Measure

- The “Samurai Cotton” series is a project that began in 2008 with the aim of creating a garment made entirely in Japan — from cotton cultivation in Hyogo to spinning, dyeing, knitting and sewing. Simple in appearance, the focus is placed on the texture and character of the fabric itself.

The fabric is made using a specially spun Samurai Cotton slub yarn, slowly knitted into a heavyweight jersey with a subtle dry hand feel and an uneven nep texture. Natural cotton specks are intentionally left in the fabric, giving it a unique appearance and raw character. Despite the firmness and texture, the fabric still retains a softness and warmth that gradually becomes more comfortable with wear.

The dyeing and construction follow the same careful approach. The Natural color is left unbleached to preserve the original tone of the cotton itself, while the “Kuromame” and “Chestnut” colors are garment dyed using traditional Kyoto natural dyeing ( Kusakizome ) techniques mixed with natural dyes, creating a deeper and warmer color tone. For the sewing details, four-needle flat seam construction and all-cotton thread are used throughout, balancing comfort with durability.

The warp uses Samurai’s original hard-twisted slubby yarns, rope-dyed with a specially blended combination of natural indigo and synthetic indigo to create a deep, richly layered blue. For the weft, Samurai developed an original slub yarn blended with Samurai Cotton, then dyed using a special colour extracted from cherry blossoms (Sakura).

This distinctive warp and weft combination creates a subtle pink-beige sakura tone beneath the indigo surface, adding a soft contrast that gradually becomes more expressive with wear.

Finished with a full set of specially developed Sakura details, including silver-plated iron Sakura buttons and rivets, copper coin-style rivets, AI + printed pocket bags, and a dedicated leather patch with an individual serial number. These exclusive details give the S500AX-SAKURA its own character and make it a special model within the Samurai collection.

product.title: Samurai Jeans SSS26-KSKW “Kanoko Ai-Madara” Sashiko Work Shirt – Natural Indigo x Brown
product.body_html:
• Intro
  • Details
  • Size Chart
  • How We Measure

- A classic two-flap-pocket work shirt built with Samurai Jeans’ newly developed “Kanoko Ai-Madara” fabric. Drawing inspiration from kanoko, the spotted appearance of a young deer, and madara, meaning a mottled or marbled pattern, the fabric recreates this naturally irregular character through colour, texture and weaving techniques.

The distinctive “Ai-Madara” marbled appearance is created with natural indigo and indigo-dyed yarns in the warp, combined with brown-dyed yarns in the weft, using sashiko weaving techniques throughout the fabric. The indigo yarns are positioned in the raised sashiko sections, where abrasion and fading occur more easily, allowing the irregular spotted pattern to become more visible. At the same time, the unique construction gives the fabric a firm, substantial texture and the durability required for long-term wear.

Designed as a classic work shirt, it features durable triple-stitched Flat-Felled Seam construction throughout. Combining traditional workwear construction with Samurai Jeans’ development of an original textile, the shirt goes beyond simple workwear and reflects the craftsmanship, textile knowledge and attention to detail that define Japanese manufacturing.

product.title: Warehouse Dead Stock Blue S1003XX-LTD 14oz Selvedge Denim - 30th Anniversary
product.body_html:
• Intro
  • Details
  • Size Chart
  • How We Measure

- Created to mark Warehouse’s 30th anniversary, the S1003XX-LTD is a limited-edition version of the WWII-era five-pocket jean. Drawing on original garments and the material restrictions that shaped denim production during the 1940s, the model recreates not only the construction and details of the period, but also the distinctive feel and atmosphere of the era that gave these jeans their unmistakable character.

Built from approximately 14oz, 6.7 × 6.7 count selvedge denim produced by Kurabo — the first Kurabo denim ever used by Warehouse. The fabric is blended with brown cotton, giving the denim a slightly rough texture and naturally uneven appearance. Woven with a white and pink selvedge ID, the denim gradually fades to a soft, dusty blue, while the uneven surface becomes more visible with wear, creating a dry and richly textured vintage character.

WWII-inspired details such as iron tack buttons, original flannel pocket bags and a rayon red tab define the design. Bringing together Warehouse’s three decades of research, experience and passion for vintage denim, the S1003XX-LTD represents a culmination of that work and stands as one of its most historically focused denim releases.

- The 946A Chino is a long-standing model in Deluxeware’s bottoms collection. Inspired by classic military chinos, it brings together design elements from multiple eras while respecting its vintage origins and remaining practical for everyday wear.

Built from a high-density chino cloth woven in Osaka using strongly twisted No.14 and No.16 American cotton yarns, the fabric goes beyond simply reproducing traditional military chino cloth. The exceptionally dense weave enhances durability while retaining the crisp texture and dry hand characteristic of classic chinos. Firm at first, the fabric gradually softens with wear, becoming increasingly comfortable over time.

Features a regular straight fit, creating a clean and versatile silhouette suited to a wide range of styling. While the standard model is produced only with a longer L34 inseam, this Mention special order also includes a shorter L32 option, offering a more practical ready-to-wear length without the need for hemming.

Shoulder Width

- Measure straight across from shoulder seam to shoulder seam on the back.

Chest Width

- Measure straight across the front of the garment, from armpit to armpit.For size chart reference, chest measurement is shown as full circumference ( flat measurement x 2 ).

Waist Width

- Measure across the narrowest part of the shirt — from seam to seam — between the chest and the hem.

Hem Width

- Measure straight across the bottom edge of the shirt, from one side seam to the other — just above the curved hem.

Sleeve Length (Set-In)

- Measure from the top of the shoulder seam straight to the end of the cuff.

Sleeve Length (Raglan)

- Measure from seam of collar all the way down to the end of the cuff.

Armhole

- Measure vertically from the shoulder seam down to the bottom of the armhole seam.

Body Length

- Measure from the center of the base of the collar (just below the collar band) straight down to the bottom hem.

Waist

- Measure straight across the top of the waistband from edge to edge, then double the measurement.

Front Rise

- Measure the front rise from the crotch seam straight up to the top of the front waistband.

Back Rise

- Measure from the crotch seam to the top of the back waistband.

Hip Width

- Measure 7.5 cm (or 3 inches) up from the crotch seam, then go straight across from side to side while laid flat, then double the measurement.

Thigh Width

- Measure horizontally from the crotch seam straight out to the outer edge of the thigh.

Knee

- Measure 33 cm (or 13 inches) down from the crotch seam along the inside leg seam.

- Measure straight across the leg from one side to the other.

Inseam

- Measure from the crotch stitch all the way to the end of the leg.

Leg Opening

- Measure straight across the bottom cuff — from one side of the leg opening to the other.
